final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) as group_avg FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordersmark), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.ordersmark, s1.group_avg, (s1.group_avg - s2.overall_avg) as diff_3 FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.group_avg > s2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg_4 FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.ordersmark, s3.group_avg, s3.diff_3, (s3.group_avg - s4.overall_avg_4) as diff_5 FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 WHERE s4.overall_avg_4 IS NOT NULL AND s3.group_avg > s4.overall_avg_4) SELECT AVG(group_avg) as avg_group_averages, AVG(diff_3) as avg_step3_diffs, AVG(diff_5) as avg_step5_diffs FROM step5
